description: Every permit a project needs at a Texas address or coordinate, from federal and state agencies down to the county and city that govern the spot: agency, permit, why it applies, review time (measured from TCEQ records or quoted from the agency, never estimated), fee where published, form link and a verbatim quote with its source URL. Includes permit holds and moratoria in force (for example the TCEQ pause on permits related to data center projects) and flags which permits they block. Works for data centers, battery storage, solar and advanced manufacturing. Use when someone asks what permits they need, how long permitting takes, whether anything is on hold, what the county or city requires, about wastewater discharge or pretreatment permits, or for the permitting picture before buying land. Free shows who governs the spot and how many holds apply; Pro lists every permit with review times and hold detail; Enterprise adds the sequenced timeline with the critical path and the TxDOT driveway form packet.

address.description: Texas street address, e.g. '1201 Main St, Houston, TX'. Use this or lat/lng.

building_sf.description: Building floor area in square feet.

disturbed_acres.description: Acres of soil disturbed during construction.

height_ft.description: Tallest structure or crane height in feet above ground.

lat.description: Latitude (WGS84). Use with lng instead of address.

lng.description: Longitude (WGS84). Use with lat instead of address.

oil_storage_gal.description: Aboveground oil storage capacity in gallons (fuel tanks, transformer oil).

onsite_gen_mw.description: On-site generation that runs beyond emergency use (MW). 0 if none.

wastewater.description: Where process water / cooling blowdown goes.

name: permit_plan
title: Permits required at a Texas site
